name: Ukanai Kao Shita Onna no Ko
original_name: 浮かない顔した女の子
source:
Around the time he entered Tsukidani High School, Shō fell in love at first sight with a girl named Tanishizuku Shizuku. However, becoming close with the girl he was infatuated with wasn't so simple, and a year passed. But when he joined the light music club in his second year, Tanishizuku Shizuku was there. Yet, as expected, things didn't progress easily like in a romantic comedy; he confessed his feelings and was rejected.

A few days after being rejected, Shō witnessed Shizuku engaging in self-harm by cutting her wrist. While his mind was already preoccupied with this, the club president, Andō Airi, ordered him to form a band with Shizuku and Akane for the school festival live.

Matsukaze Akane is on good terms with Shō and strives to help mend the relationship between him and Shizuku. Airi is often lost in thought. What secrets do these three adolescent girls hold within their hearts? And will Shō and the others successfully pull off their school festival live performance?

This is a voiced sound novel depicting a realistic youth story!
